objective: Validate saved checkpoint bytes/task/root before ordinary ResumeEngine.attempt_resume mutations

acceptance_cases.required: Existing suspended task with valid checkpoint and no active blockers resumes once; normal return shape, fence, lease and graph transition remain correct
Digest mismatch fails closed before any resume mutation
Invalid encoding/JSON or missing required checkpoint fields cannot authorize resume
Validly hashed checkpoint for another task is rejected with no resume mutation
Validly hashed checkpoint from another root is rejected with no resume mutation
Existing sibling blocker rejection remains intact
Existing stale-token and non-suspended duplicate rejection remain intact

implementation_constraints: Use restore_checkpoint to validate checkpoint integrity and require matching task_id and root_mission_id before advancing any fencing token, lease, ledger or graph state.
Preserve attempt_resume signature and tuple result contract, valid resume behavior, active-sibling rejection and stale-token/duplicate rejection.
Malformed, absent, missing, corrupted or wrong-lineage checkpoint cannot authorize resume; rejected attempts leave graph, fencing, lease state and ledger unchanged.
Do not invent stage identity binding: TaskNode has no canonical checkpoint stage identity.
No changes outside the exact two mutable paths; recover_interrupted_resume, lease hydration, watchdog wiring, generic production profiles and custody implementation remain outside scope.

test_construction.dependencies: Use real MissionDependencyGraph, ResumeEngine, CAS/FilesystemCasStore and Ledger/SqliteLedgerStore in isolated temporary fixture stores; no mocked checkpoint acceptance or test-only production hooks.
test_construction.execution_boundary: All commands run from the runtime-emitted sandbox against verified candidate import origins, with no dependency installation/provider calls; harness-bound interpreter/env and temporary paths must be recorded. These are test fixtures, not production autonomy proof.
